name: Utopia
fix_description: Remove the _airdrop function entirely. It serves no legitimate purpose (only emits fake Transfer events for marketing) but introduces a critical vulnerability: attackers can craft tAmount to make airdropAddress equal the pair contract address, overwriting its balance to 1 and manipulating pool reserves.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is short, but it relies on understanding a protocol-specific business logic flaw in the token’s airdrop/random-address mechanism and how it interacts with PancakePair skim/sync reserve accounting. It is more than a trivial access-control bug, yet still only a few steps and limited cross-protocol complexity, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it within 30 minutes to 2 hours.
